summary: Diag5: RBF SVM on screened mains + pairwise products (interaction space), pilot-only
reasoning: Step-25 contradicted step-23: stability, L1/linear screens, robust transforms and small-k all stay ≤ 0.672. Bar to proceed toward the repeated-nested estimate: fold-refit plain-CV seed-0 mean AUC >= 0.70; if reached, the winner gets fully nested re-estimation before freezing.
